UPON hearing the counsel, the Court made the following  O R D E R 1.

Learned senior counsel for the State of Tamil Nadu submits that the acquisition process has commenced and a notification under Section 11 of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 (in short, the Act),
has been issued on 12.08.2024.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: 2. Let the State take all necessary steps in accordance with the procedure prescribed under the Act for acquisition of the land.
A status report in this regard be filed by the next date of hearing.
3. The prayer in this application is to stay the acquisition proceedings.
Such a prayer, in our considered opinion, is directly in teeth of the order dated 09.02.2024 passed after hearing all the parties.
No case to grant interim stay is made out.

The Interlocutory Application is, accordingly,
dismissed.
4. Post the main case for hearing on 04.10.2024.

(ARJUN BISHT) (PREETHI T.C.)
ASTT.
